title: M7 finite-group full-stabilizer orbit fibers and filtered exact division
scope: Standard Group/MulAction/FintypeG only. Actual M7 action installation and factorized arithmetic numerator specialization remain separate gates. Semantic orbit appears only as proof-side count.

spec.name: M7.OrbitFibers.fiber_equiv
spec.statement: ∀ (G : Type) [Group G] [Fintype G] (X : Type) [MulAction G X] (c : X), ∀ g₀ : G, Nonempty ({h : G // h • c = c} ≃ {g : G // g • c = g₀ • c})
queries: MulAction orbit stabilizer equivalence fiber cardinality
spec.guidance: Construct the actual equivalence by h↦g0*h and g↦g0⁻¹*g. Use mul_smul and inverse identities, Subtype.ext for inverse laws. This includes nonfaithful actions; no orbit cardinality is assumed. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M7.OrbitFibers.stabilizer_positive
spec.statement: ∀ (G : Type) [Group G] [Fintype G] (X : Type) [MulAction G X] (c : X), 0 < M7.OrbitFibers.stabilizerCount G c
queries: MulAction orbit stabilizer equivalence fiber cardinality
spec.guidance: Unfold stabilizerCount, Finset.card_pos/mem_filter explicitly and supply 1 with one_smul. Avoid change introducing a different classical filter decider. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M7.OrbitFibers.fiber_count
spec.statement: ∀ (G : Type) [Group G] [Fintype G] (X : Type) [MulAction G X] (c : X), ∀ y ∈ M7.OrbitFibers.orbit G c, M7.OrbitFibers.fiberCount G c y = M7.OrbitFibers.stabilizerCount G c
queries: MulAction orbit stabilizer equivalence fiber cardinality
spec.guidance: Extract actual g0 from orbit membership and use fiber_equiv cardinality. Bridge the filter cards with Nat.card/Fintype.card of the actual subtypes; use explicit finite membership transport to handle classical instances. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M7.OrbitFibers.action_count_product
spec.statement: ∀ (G : Type) [Group G] [Fintype G] (X : Type) [MulAction G X] (c : X), ∀ P : X → Prop, M7.OrbitFibers.actionCount G c P = M7.OrbitFibers.orbitCount G c P * M7.OrbitFibers.stabilizerCount G c
queries: MulAction orbit stabilizer equivalence fiber cardinality
spec.guidance: Partition the filtered action records by their actual images, over the finite orbit.filter P. Each nonempty fiber is exactly the full stabilizer cardinal by fiber_count. Use finite sum-fiber cardinality or a subtype-to-Sigma equivalence; no Fintype X assumption or freely supplied uniform-fiber hypothesis. Return tactic lines only without leading by. Available exact local API: Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise or Finset.card_eq_sum_card_image in Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Basic; these do not require Fintype X.

spec.name: M7.OrbitFibers.orbit_count_div
spec.statement: ∀ (G : Type) [Group G] [Fintype G] (X : Type) [MulAction G X] (c : X), ∀ P : X → Prop, M7.OrbitFibers.actionCount G c P / M7.OrbitFibers.stabilizerCount G c = M7.OrbitFibers.orbitCount G c P ∧ M7.OrbitFibers.stabilizerCount G c ∣ M7.OrbitFibers.actionCount G c P
queries: MulAction orbit stabilizer equivalence fiber cardinality
spec.guidance: Rewrite raw product identity and cancel the positive full stabilizer using Nat.mul_div_cancel. Also explicitly establish divisibility, not merely rounded division output. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M7.OrbitFibers.orbit_partition
spec.statement: ∀ (G : Type) [Group G] [Fintype G] (X : Type) [MulAction G X] (c : X), ∀ (P : X → Prop) (test : X → Bool), M7.OrbitFibers.orbitCount G c P = M7.OrbitFibers.orbitCount G c (fun y => P y ∧ test y = false) + M7.OrbitFibers.orbitCount G c (fun y => P y ∧ test y = true)
queries: MulAction orbit stabilizer equivalence fiber cardinality
spec.guidance: Split the actual filtered semantic orbit into two disjoint exhaustive Boolean children. Cardinality or indicator-sum proof; no assumptions about faithfulness, prefix syntax or positivity. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M7.OrbitFibers.action_partition
spec.statement: ∀ (G : Type) [Group G] [Fintype G] (X : Type) [MulAction G X] (c : X), ∀ (P : X → Prop) (test : X → Bool), M7.OrbitFibers.actionCount G c P = M7.OrbitFibers.actionCount G c (fun y => P y ∧ test y = false) + M7.OrbitFibers.actionCount G c (fun y => P y ∧ test y = true)
queries: MulAction orbit stabilizer equivalence fiber cardinality
spec.guidance: Same Boolean partition on actual action records. Count records with multiplicity; do not identify records with orbit points. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
